rules.landmark: NavList is a <nav>; give it aria-label when a page hosts more than one.
rules.current: Set current on the active NavListLink; it renders aria-current="page".
rules.role: This is a list of links, not a menu: no role="menu" or menuitem semantics.
rules.host: The same NavList composes inside Sidebar or Navbar with only the orientation changing; it does not belong to either.
